method: Playwright Chromium, page screenshot only — no browser chrome, no OS chrome, no cursor.
notes: Bhoonaksha frames are live captures from https://bhunaksha.vercel.app/. Government Jharbhoomi forms could not be loaded from this capture environment (TCP to 103.97.108.122:443 connects; TLS handshake times out; WebFetch returns HTTP 500). Those two stills were not fabricated.

location_used.place: Mandar area, west of Ranchi, Jharkhand
location_used.why: Live JSAC cadastral tiles are present here. Rural fields and a national highway give geographic context for the family story without inventing a plot.

shots.purpose: The citizen needs to know the administrative structure (District, Anchal, Mauja, Khata, khatadhari name, captcha) before reaching the record.
shots.notes: Official RoR search page did not load. Not fabricated. Public page title when reachable: अपना खाता देखे / View your account. Re-run `npm run capture` from an India network to fill this still.

shots.purpose: What happened to this land over time? Register-II / plot transaction history.
shots.notes: Official Register-II / khesra-wise history page did not load. Not fabricated. Public page asks for District, Anchal, Halka, Mauja, Khata, Khesra, captcha. Re-run from an India network to fill this still.

shots.screen_state: Citizen landing map, default clean India view. Search closed. Lekhpal desk not opened.
shots.purpose: Appears immediately after: What if we started with the land itself?
shots.notes: Live default boot. Map/Satellite/Labels, See India, measure, tools, Lekhpal desk link all visible. IP is outside India so the prototype stays on the national frame.

shots.screen_state: Search opened and focused. Placeholder: Village, city, plot, or DIGIPIN. Near me suggestion visible. No query submitted.
shots.purpose: Citizen can start with something they know rather than the full government hierarchy.
shots.notes: Did not submit a search just to populate results.

shots.screen_state: Satellite + live JSAC cadastral parcel boundaries near Mandar, Ranchi district. Plot numbers visible. NH visible. No plot selected.
shots.purpose: Land appears on familiar geography. One of the most important stills.
shots.notes: Zoomed until individual plots are readable. Parcel layer is the live prototype tile source, not a redraw.

shots.notes: Captured from the local UI change (not yet on vercel). Family land status is a plot-card fact, not a separate slide. Note under the facts: Our family's land — not a live Record of Rights.

shots.screen_state: Plot card fact grid: Then / Today sit beside Survey no., Area, DIGIPIN, Khata, Holder, Kisam.
shots.purpose: Actions and description items around the selected plot, including family land class.
shots.notes: Today is accent-colored. Empty Khata/Holder/Kisam remain dashes. Not a fabricated RoR.

shots.screen_state: Live measure tool: vertices on the map, 206 m / 4584 m² with bigha, biswa, acre, hectare.
shots.purpose: What are the actual boundaries and how large is it?
shots.notes: Used the real citizen measure control. Sketch is a measurement on the live map, not a fake survey extract.

shots.screen_state: Plot card for Survey no. 23 with Official RoR link, plus the live toast: No public data for this yet. Coming when a state opens it.
shots.purpose: The plot is the anchor from which the citizen reaches the record.
shots.notes: Opened Record of Rights from the tools menu on a selected plot. Did not fabricate an RoR. Official RoR is a link out to the state portal.

shots.screen_state: Get map copy print layout: satellite + parcels on top, plot facts below, chrome hidden by the product print stylesheet.
shots.purpose: Map copy from the selected plot.
shots.notes: Clicking Get map copy calls window.print(). This still is that print media layout, not a reconstructed PDF.

shots.screen_state: Send to bank clicked. Live toast: Bank pack queued. A Record of Rights still needs a state to join.
shots.purpose: Sharing / send-to-bank interaction as it exists in the current prototype.
shots.notes: Functional as a queued-pack toast. No fake bank portal.

shots.screen_state: Lekhpal desk workspace: professional tool rail, Citizen map switch, satellite + cadastral parcels, catalogue/compare controls.

shots.notes: Opened the live lekpal.html. Same Mandar / Ranchi district location as the citizen sequence.

shots.screen_state: Lekhpal identify with the same Then / Today fact rows on the professional inspector.

shots.notes: Family land facts use the shared Passport plot card on the Lekhpal desk.

shots.screen_state: Same plot card as 07: Then Raiyati and Today Gair Mazarua as ordinary description items.
